email.body1:
Steven, saw Corcentric expanded its ecosystem with Unite's European marketplace and a Workato integration push.

That kind of expansion usually opens more accounts than the team can cover before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Corcentric off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Steven, quick follow-up for Corcentric.

New partner integrations expand the addressable map, but most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to capture it. The gap shows up late, and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your team needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Steven, last bit of proof for Corcentric.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Corcentric's reply rate likely compares to other procure-to-pay vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Steven, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Standing up new partner integrations is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a procure-to-pay motion? I'll tailor it to Corcentric either way.
